title: Claude Code Gets These 3 MCPs or It's Useless
description:
The first three MCP servers every Claude Code user should install: GitHub MCP (live inside your repo, issues, and pull requests), Notion or Linear MCP (real tasks and specs), and Playwright MCP (open a browser and verify the build). This is the starter stack that turns Claude Code from a chatbot into a real coding setup. #Shorts #ClaudeCode #mcp 

Get the full starter pack here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1n2zF6Rb2K3EEj9IYK61cVWvaybhWFYjE/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=110897400342351178452&rtpof=true&sd=true
